'''Plasma shells''' were a type of ammunition fired by [[Assault cannon/Legends|assault cannons]].<ref name="EGTD" /> The [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]-based warhead was the primary firing mode for the weapon, and it was extremely powerful.<ref name="DF-OPG">''[[Dark Forces Official Player's Guide]]''</ref>
